construction: Four native 15.008-second H3 shots; shots 2-4 use the previous shot's last frame as first-frame conditioning. 30-second deliverables concatenate shots 1-2; 60-second deliverables concatenate shots 1-4.
boundary_evidence: At 14.8s the edited shot is blue, but at 15.2s the next shot starts red; the same reset is visible at later boundaries because the unedited first-frame latent is stronger than the edited text-condition direction.
overall: H3 shot chaining produces usable 30/60-second story continuity. Applying only a condition-vector edit to independently cached shots does not yield seamless cross-shot attribute continuity unless the first-frame/image latent is edited or regenerated too.
